milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because the suspicious_stew starts inside the chest (not in player inventory). When it appears in the player's inventory, it proves the chest was opened and the item was retrieved. This is the most reliable proxy for 'open chest' since there is no direct chest-open event in the info dict.

Uses inventory_has for bowl because eating any stew in Minecraft always returns a bowl to the player's inventory. The player starts with no bowl and there is no other source of bowls in the scene, so detecting bowl (min_count=1) is an unambiguous signal that the suspicious_stew was consumed.
